slots.instagram_caption:

slots.image_prompt: OBJECT PASSPORT: exactly one fitted bed sheet or top sheet (object locked as one fitted bed sheet or top sheet; every surface is blank: no printed, embossed, woven or stitched marks, letters, labels or emblems of any size); color/material: used warm-white cotton percale sheet; wear marks: patchy yellowing from sweat, mildew, or detergent residue across the contact face. WEAR FIRST (this is the story of the photo): sweat darkening as a clearly darker tide line that follows the contact shape, with salt-white rims at its border, at the positions named by the topic (patchy yellowing from sweat, mildew, or detergent residue across the contact face); it covers roughly 25-40% of that area and is strong enough to read at thumbnail size from arm's length, on the side that faces the camera; the rest of the object is clean enough that the marked area is unmistakably the problem, but the object is a used everyday item, not new stock. MATERIAL OPTICS: the fabric shows its real weave or knit texture at close range, matte with a faint sheen only along fold ridges; worn or soiled areas read as clearly darker regions that follow the contact line, with a visible edge, never as painted patches. SCENE LOCK: the same wooden counter in front of the garment conveyor rail on every slide; do not change location, backdrop, or room across slides. Create one portrait 4:5 photo. Keep the exact featured object consistent across all four photos. LOCATION: a worn light-oak wooden counter in front of the garment conveyor rail, plastic-covered finished clothes hanging softly out of focus behind, a paper ticket clipped to one hanger (unreadable), a tape measure coiled at the frame edge; no pink mat. COMPOSITION (hero, crop allowed): frame the half of the object that carries the problem, the object cut by the frame edge on one side and set off-centre with its mass near x=40% or x=60%, filling 60-75% of the frame height; one adult hand entering from the frame edge, wrist only, fingers holding or pressing right beside the problem area with five clearly separated fingers; a handheld lint roller rests at the frame edge as a foreground occlusion; the surface fills the bottom of the frame, not empty space. LIGHTING: one clear key light from a window on one side: the lit side of the object is bright and the far side falls to mid-grey with a visible shadow edge running across the object; a dense contact shadow at the base that softens outward; ceiling fluorescent fills only enough to keep shadow detail; the counter or mat must not tint the whites. STYLE: candid documentary phone photo taken by the shop worker mid-inspection, the action caught while it happens, slight handheld tilt and framing imperfection; not editorial, not catalogue, not studio. CAMERA: phone main camera, 26mm-equivalent, held from the worker's standing eye line looking down about 25 degrees, f/1.8 look: the problem area sharp, the far side of the object slightly softer, the background clearly out of focus. COLOR: neutral daylight indoor tone with honest contrast, low saturation close to documentary colour, whites read white where clean and grey where soiled; no pink or warm cast on the object. Photo 1 of 4. Hero still of 被單上一片一片的黃，先分汗、霉、還是洗劑殘留 through the passport item as the main close-up on the locked inspection counter. Keep the object recognizable even when cropped and do not imply a cleaning result. Avoid: readable label text, a second duvet, a bedroom set, a waxy plastic-coated surface, a second hand.

slots.topic: 香奈兒雙色鞋包頭起毛先看羅緞
slots.instagram_caption:
香奈兒雙色鞋包頭起毛先看羅緞。

圖裡這雙是 CHANEL（香奈兒）雙色鞋：米色山羊皮鞋身、黑色羅緞包頭。包頭起毛多半是羅緞布紋被踢磨、刷過頭，不是皮壞了。我們收件會先看起毛只在布紋表面，還是羅緞邊已經綻線、露出底下的襯。自己拿牙刷沾水刷包頭，羅緞容易留水痕，起毛反而更明顯。

羅緞已經綻線或磨破的，清潔只能整理表面，回不到新鞋的樣子；需不需要另外修補，看過實品再說。台中市區我們免費到府收送，你先拍包頭正面和側面給我們看。

參考價：名牌鞋 $600 起（依材質與狀況報價）

slots.image_prompt: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 photo, lens at the height of a terrazzo counter in a dark room lit only by one tall north window at frame left. A single CHANEL two-tone slingback pump stands on the counter, toe toward the lens and turned slightly right: beige goatskin body, rounded black grosgrain toe cap, elastic back strap, and a 65mm leather-wrapped block heel whose small gold interlocking CC emblem sits back in shadow, soft and unremarkable. The grosgrain toe cap is the story: along its front edge the fine ribs have lifted into a soft halo of short raised fuzz, a few fine fibres catching the window light, while the cap itself stays whole and neatly stitched. The beige leather just behind the cap shows a faint grey rub line. A soft horsehair brush lies at the right frame edge. Eighty centimetres behind, a faded dark green plaster wall. The window light falls off about two stops across the shoe; neutral daylight colour, 85mm lens, slight underexposure. No tears or holes in the cap, no people, no other text.
